name: codejustwrite-monorepo
description: CodeJustWrite — terminal AI coding agent with a cloud-hosted, phone-installable PWA front end.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/core && npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/cli && npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/server && npm run build --workspace=@codejustwrite/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@codejustwrite/core && npm run test --workspace=@codejustwrite/server && npm run test:unit --workspace=@codejustwrite/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@codejustwrite/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codejustwrite/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace=@codejustwrite/server
